news.title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
news.summary: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

news.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
news.summary: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

news.title: Wells Fargo's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings double to $2.35 billion
news.summary: The bank's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF position doubled to $2.35 billion in the third quarter, giving it exposure to roughly 28,000 BTC.
